scope: 31 training-native RESET k return -0.2 V -> SET k+1 outward +0.2 V command bridges, k=4..34. Static conditional diagnostic only; not chronology simulation or full-model validation.

definitions.branch_rule: First maximum abs(command) belongs to outward; subsequent samples including repeated apex belong to return.
definitions.original_mask: isfinite(abs(I)) & abs(I)>=phase_floor & abs(V)>1e-12; RESET floor1e-12 A, SET floor1e-11 A
definitions.path: Sum abs(delta command voltage), keeping native repeated zero points and the record boundary; zero-distance samples add no path clock.
definitions.stored_current: Raw current stored without modifying sign; features use magnitude. Negative RESET command does not establish a negative sign in stored current.
definitions.timing: No timestamps, waits or dwell durations inferred. 0.4 V command path is not 0.4 seconds and does not prove absence of real-time relaxation.

limitations: These31 bridges are conditional static diagnostics; no inverse state or model trajectory was computed.
Any later conditional inverse readpoint is a diagnostic, not permission to reset model initial states.
This audit does not replace the full46pairs history, original27023-dimensional residual, or20 aggregate feature gates.
SET5..35 are within original series training4..35; they are not the original chronological holdout.
